heading: Location
text: A location can be an identifiable geographic place (ISO 19112), but it can also be a non-geographic place such as a directory, row, or column. As such, there are numerous ways in which location can be expressed, such as by a coordinate, address, landmark, and so forth.

heading: EmptyCollection
text: An empty collection is a collection without members.

heading: Plan
text: A plan is an entity that represents a set of actions or steps intended by one or more agents to achieve some goals.

heading: Start
text: Start is when an activity is deemed to have been started by an entity, known as trigger. The activity did not exist before its start. Any usage, generation, or invalidation involving an activity follows the activity's start. A start may refer to a trigger entity that set off the activity, or to an activity, known as starter, that generated the trigger.

heading: Entity
text: An entity is a physical, digital, conceptual, or other kind of thing with some fixed aspects; entities may be real or imaginary.

heading: Removal
text: Removal is a derivation that describes the transformation of a dictionary into another, by removing one or more keys.

heading: Delegation
text:
Delegation is the assignment of authority and responsibility to an agent (by itself or by another agent) to carry out a specific activity as a delegate or representative, while the agent it acts on behalf of retains some responsibility for the outcome of the delegated work.

For example, a student acted on behalf of his supervisor, who acted on behalf of the department chair, who acted on behalf of the university; all those agents are responsible in some way for the activity that took place but

heading: Replace
text: Activity that identifies the replacement of a resource.

heading: SoftwareAgent
text: A software agent is running software.

heading: Dictionary
text: A dictionary is an entity that provides a structure to some constituents, which are themselves entities. These constituents are said to be member of the dictionary.

heading: RightsHolder
text: Role with the function of owning or managing rights over a resource. The Agent assigned to this role is associated with a RightsAssignment Activity

heading: ProvenanceService
text: Type for a generic provenance query service. Mainly for use in RDF provenance query service descriptions, to facilitate discovery in linked data environments.

heading: EntityInfluence
text: EntityInfluence is the capacity of an entity to have an effect on the character, development, or behavior of another by means of usage, start, end, derivation, or other.

heading: Revision
text: A revision is a derivation for which the resulting entity is a revised version of some original. The implication here is that the resulting entity contains substantial content from the original. Revision is a particular case of derivation.

heading: InstantaneousEvent
text: The PROV data model is implicitly based on a notion of instantaneous events (or just events), that mark transitions in the world. Events include generation, usage, or invalidation of entities, as well as starting or ending of activities. This notion of event is not first-class in the data model, but it is useful for explaining its other concepts and its semantics.

heading: Modify
text: Activity that identifies the modification of a resource.

heading: RightsAssignment
text: Activity that identifies the rights assignment of a resource.

heading: Association
text: An activity association is an assignment of responsibility to an agent for an activity, indicating that the agent had a role in the activity. It further allows for a plan to be specified, which is the plan intended by the agent to achieve some goals in the context of this activity.

heading: Copyright
text: Activity that identifies the Copyrighting activity associated to a resource.

heading: Communication
text: Communication is the exchange of an entity by two activities, one activity using the entity generated by the other.

heading: Creator
text: Role with the function of creating a resource. The Agent assigned to this role is associated with a Create Activity

heading: AgentInfluence
text: AgentInfluence is the capacity of an agent to have an effect on the character, development, or behavior of another by means of attribution, association, delegation, or other.

heading: Key-Entity Pair
text: A key-entity pair. Part of a prov:Dictionary through prov:hadDictionaryMember. The key is any RDF Literal, the value is a prov:Entity.

heading: Create
text: Activity that identifies the creation of a resource

heading: Bundle
text: A bundle is a named set of provenance descriptions, and is itself an Entity, so allowing provenance of provenance to be expressed.

heading: Collection
text: A collection is an entity that provides a structure to some constituents, which are themselves entities. These constituents are said to be member of the collections.

heading: Usage
text: Usage is the beginning of utilizing an entity by an activity. Before usage, the activity had not begun to utilize this entity and could not have been affected by the entity.

heading: Submit
text: Activity that identifies the issuance (e.g., publication) of a resource.

heading: PrimarySource
text:
A primary source for a topic refers to something produced by some agent with direct experience and knowledge about the topic, at the time of the topic's study, without benefit from hindsight.

Because of the directness of primary sources, they 'speak for themselves' in ways that cannot be captured through the filter of secondary sources. As such, it is important for secondary sources to reference those primary sources from which they were derived, so that their reliability can be investigated.

heading: Generation
text: Generation is the completion of production of a new entity by an activity. This entity did not exist before generation and becomes available for usage after this generation.

heading: Organization
text: An organization is a social or legal institution such as a company, society, etc.

heading: Insertion
text: Insertion is a derivation that describes the transformation of a dictionary into another, by insertion of one or more key-entity pairs.

heading: Accept
text: Activity that identifies the acceptance of a resource (e.g., an article in a conference)

heading: Role
text: A role is the function of an entity or agent with respect to an activity, in the context of a usage, generation, invalidation, association, start, and end.

heading: Publisher
text: Role with the function of publishing a resource. The Agent assigned to this role is associated with a Publish Activity

heading: Person
text: Person agents are people.

heading: Invalidation
text: Invalidation is the start of the destruction, cessation, or expiry of an existing entity by an activity. The entity is no longer available for use (or further invalidation) after invalidation. Any generation or usage of an entity precedes its invalidation.

heading: ServiceDescription
text: Type for a generic provenance query service. Mainly for use in RDF provenance query service descriptions, to facilitate discovery in linked data environments.

heading: Quotation
text: A quotation is the repeat of (some or all of) an entity, such as text or image, by someone who may or may not be its original author. Quotation is a particular case of derivation.

heading: Publish
text: Activity that identifies the publication of a resource

heading: Derivation
text: A derivation is a transformation of an entity into another, an update of an entity resulting in a new one, or the construction of a new entity based on a pre-existing entity.

heading: Contribute
text: Activity that identifies any contribution of an agent to a resource.

heading: Agent
text: An agent is something that bears some form of responsibility for an activity taking place, for the existence of an entity, or for another agent's activity.

heading: Attribution
text:
Attribution is the ascribing of an entity to an agent.

When an entity e is attributed to agent ag, entity e was generated by some unspecified activity that in turn was associated to agent ag. Thus, this relation is useful when the activity is not known, or irrelevant.

heading: ActivityInfluence
text: ActivitiyInfluence is the capacity of an activity to have an effect on the character, development, or behavior of another by means of generation, invalidation, communication, or other.

heading: End
text: End is when an activity is deemed to have been ended by an entity, known as trigger. The activity no longer exists after its end. Any usage, generation, or invalidation involving an activity precedes the activity's end. An end may refer to a trigger entity that terminated the activity, or to an activity, known as ender that generated the trigger.

heading: Contributor
text: Role with the function of having responsibility for making contributions to a resource. The Agent assigned to this role is associated with a Modify or Create Activities

heading: Influence
text: Influence is the capacity of an entity, activity, or agent to have an effect on the character, development, or behavior of another by means of usage, start, end, generation, invalidation, communication, derivation, attribution, association, or delegation.

heading: Empty Dictionary
text: An empty dictionary (i.e. has no members).

heading: Activity
text: An activity is something that occurs over a period of time and acts upon or with entities; it may include consuming, processing, transforming, modifying, relocating, using, or generating entities.

heading: asInBundle
text:
prov:asInBundle is used to specify which bundle the general entity of a prov:mentionOf property is described.

When :x prov:mentionOf :y and :y is described in Bundle :b, the triple :x prov:asInBundle :b is also asserted to cite the Bundle in which :y was described.

heading: describesService
text: relates a generic provenance query service resource (type prov:ServiceDescription) to a specific query service description (e.g. a prov:DirectQueryService or a sd:Service).

heading: hadDictionaryMember
text: Describes the key-entity pair that was member of a prov:Dictionary. A dictionary can have multiple members.

heading: has_anchor
text: Indicates anchor URI for a potentially dynamic resource instance.

heading: has_provenance
text: Indicates a provenance-URI for a resource; the resource identified by this property presents a provenance record about its subject or anchor resource.

heading: hasProvenanceService
text: Indicates a provenance query service that can access provenance related to its subject or anchor resource.

heading: provenance pingback
text: Relates a resource to a provenance pingback service that may receive additional provenance links about the resource.

heading: qualifiedInsertion
text: prov:qualifiedInsertion shows the details of an insertion, in particular the inserted key-entity pairs.

heading: qualifiedRemoval
text: prov:qualifiedRemoval shows the details of a removal, in particular the removed keys.

heading: derivedByInsertionFrom
text: The dictionary was derived from the other by insertion. Can be qualified with prov:qualifiedInsertion, which shows details of the insertion, in particular the inserted key-entity pairs.

heading: derivedByRemovalFrom
text: The dictionary was derived from the other by removal. Can be qualified with prov:qualifiedRemoval, which shows details of the removal, in particular the removed keys.

heading: hadGeneration
text: The _optional_ Generation involved in an Entity's Derivation.

heading: hadPlan
text: The _optional_ Plan adopted by an Agent in Association with some Activity. Plan specifications are out of the scope of this specification.

heading: hadUsage
text: The _optional_ Usage involved in an Entity's Derivation.

heading: insertedKeyEntityPair
text: An object property to refer to the prov:KeyEntityPair inserted into a prov:Dictionary.

heading: mentionOf
text:
prov:mentionOf is used to specialize an entity as described in another bundle. It is to be used in conjuction with prov:asInBundle.

prov:asInBundle is used to cite the Bundle in which the generalization was mentioned.

heading: pairKey
text: The entity of a prov:KeyEntityPair, which is an element of a prov:Dictionary.

heading: atLocation
text: The Location of any resource.

heading: dictionary
text: The property used by a prov:Insertion and prov:Removal to cite the prov:Dictionary that was prov:derivedByInsertionFrom or prov:derivedByRemovalFrom another dictionary.

heading: hadActivity
text: This property has multiple RDFS domains to suit multiple OWL Profiles. See PROV-O OWL Profile.

heading: hadRole
text: prov:hadRole references the Role (i.e. the function of an entity with respect to an activity), in the context of an instantaneous usage, generation, association, start, and end.

heading: wasInformedBy
text: An activity a2 is dependent on or informed by another activity a1, by way of some unspecified entity that is generated by a1 and used by a2.

heading: actedOnBehalfOf
text: An object property to express the accountability of an agent towards another agent. The subordinate agent acted on behalf of the responsible agent in an actual activity.

heading: alternateOf
text: Two alternate entities present aspects of the same thing. These aspects may be the same or different, and the alternate entities may or may not overlap in time.

heading: qualifiedAssociation
text: If this Activity prov:wasAssociatedWith Agent :ag, then it can qualify the Association using prov:qualifiedAssociation [ a prov:Association;  prov:agent :ag; :foo :bar ].

heading: qualifiedAttribution
text: If this Entity prov:wasAttributedTo Agent :ag, then it can qualify how it was influenced using prov:qualifiedAttribution [ a prov:Attribution;  prov:agent :ag; :foo :bar ].

heading: qualifiedCommunication
text: If this Activity prov:wasInformedBy Activity :a, then it can qualify how it was influenced using prov:qualifiedCommunication [ a prov:Communication;  prov:activity :a; :foo :bar ].

heading: qualifiedDelegation
text: If this Agent prov:actedOnBehalfOf Agent :ag, then it can qualify how with prov:qualifiedResponsibility [ a prov:Responsibility;  prov:agent :ag; :foo :bar ].

heading: qualifiedEnd
text: If this Activity prov:wasEndedBy Entity :e1, then it can qualify how it was ended using prov:qualifiedEnd [ a prov:End;  prov:entity :e1; :foo :bar ].

heading: qualifiedGeneration
text: If this Activity prov:generated Entity :e, then it can qualify how it performed the Generation using prov:qualifiedGeneration [ a prov:Generation;  prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ].

heading: qualifiedInvalidation
text: If this Entity prov:wasInvalidatedBy Activity :a, then it can qualify how it was invalidated using prov:qualifiedInvalidation [ a prov:Invalidation;  prov:activity :a; :foo :bar ].

heading: qualifiedPrimarySource
text: If this Entity prov:hadPrimarySource Entity :e, then it can qualify how using prov:qualifiedPrimarySource [ a prov:PrimarySource; prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ].

heading: qualifiedQuotation
text: If this Entity prov:wasQuotedFrom Entity :e, then it can qualify how using prov:qualifiedQuotation [ a prov:Quotation;  prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ].

heading: qualifiedRevision
text: If this Entity prov:wasRevisionOf Entity :e, then it can qualify how it was revised using prov:qualifiedRevision [ a prov:Revision;  prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ].

heading: qualifiedStart
text: If this Activity prov:wasStartedBy Entity :e1, then it can qualify how it was started using prov:qualifiedStart [ a prov:Start;  prov:entity :e1; :foo :bar ].

heading: qualifiedUsage
text: If this Activity prov:used Entity :e, then it can qualify how it used it using prov:qualifiedUsage [ a prov:Usage; prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ].

heading: specializationOf
text: An entity that is a specialization of another shares all aspects of the latter, and additionally presents more specific aspects of the same thing as the latter. In particular, the lifetime of the entity being specialized contains that of any specialization. Examples of aspects include a time period, an abstraction, and a context associated with the entity.

heading: used
text: A prov:Entity that was used by this prov:Activity. For example, :baking prov:used :spoon, :egg, :oven .

heading: wasAssociatedWith
text: An prov:Agent that had some (unspecified) responsibility for the occurrence of this prov:Activity.

heading: wasEndedBy
text: End is when an activity is deemed to have ended. An end may refer to an entity, known as trigger, that terminated the activity.

heading: wasStartedBy
text: Start is when an activity is deemed to have started. A start may refer to an entity, known as trigger, that initiated the activity.

heading: influencer
text: This property is used as part of the qualified influence pattern. Subclasses of prov:Influence use these subproperties to reference the resource (Entity, Agent, or Activity) whose influence is being qualified.

heading: wasAttributedTo
text: Attribution is the ascribing of an entity to an agent.

heading: wasQuotedFrom
text: An entity is derived from an original entity by copying, or 'quoting', some or all of it.

heading: wasRevisionOf
text: A revision is a derivation that revises an entity into a revised version.

heading: activity
text: The prov:activity property references an prov:Activity which influenced a resource. This property applies to an prov:ActivityInfluence, which is given by a subproperty of prov:qualifiedInfluence from the influenced prov:Entity, prov:Activity or prov:Agent.

heading: agent
text: The prov:agent property references an prov:Agent which influenced a resource. This property applies to an prov:AgentInfluence, which is given by a subproperty of prov:qualifiedInfluence from the influenced prov:Entity, prov:Activity or prov:Agent.

heading: qualifiedDerivation
text: If this Entity prov:wasDerivedFrom Entity :e, then it can qualify how it was derived using prov:qualifiedDerivation [ a prov:Derivation;  prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ].

heading: entity
text: The prov:entity property references an prov:Entity which influenced a resource. This property applies to an prov:EntityInfluence, which is given by a subproperty of prov:qualifiedInfluence from the influenced prov:Entity, prov:Activity or prov:Agent.

heading: wasDerivedFrom
text: A derivation is a transformation of an entity into another, an update of an entity resulting in a new one, or the construction of a new entity based on a pre-existing entity.

heading: qualifiedInfluence
text: Because prov:qualifiedInfluence is a broad relation, the more specific relations (qualifiedCommunication, qualifiedDelegation, qualifiedEnd, etc.) should be used when applicable.

heading: wasInfluencedBy
text: Because prov:wasInfluencedBy is a broad relation, its more specific subproperties (e.g. prov:wasInformedBy, prov:actedOnBehalfOf, prov:wasEndedBy, etc.) should be used when applicable.

heading: provenanceUriTemplate
text: Relates a provenance service to a URI template string for constructing provenance-URIs.

heading: value
text: Provides a value that is a direct representation of an entity.

heading: endedAtTime
text: The time at which an activity ended. See also prov:startedAtTime.

heading: generatedAtTime
text: The time at which an entity was completely created and is available for use.

heading: invalidatedAtTime
text: The time at which an entity was invalidated (i.e., no longer usable).

heading: pairKey
text: The key of a prov:KeyEntityPair, which is an element of a prov:Dictionary.

heading: removedKey
text: The key removed in a Removal.

heading: startedAtTime
text: The time at which an activity started. See also prov:endedAtTime.

heading: atTime
text: The time at which an InstantaneousEvent occurred, in the form of xsd:dateTime.
